title: Ship iOS 4.2 on Monday
transcript:
[00:00] Hana: The iOS release. Where are we?
[00:04] Luis: Build 4.2 is in TestFlight. Two crash reports from beta testers, both on older iPads.
[00:11] Hana: Is that a blocker?
[00:12] Luis: Not for phones. I'd ship phones now and fix the iPad crash in 4.2.1.
[00:18] Hana: OK. Submit to App Store review on Wednesday, then.
[00:23] Luis: Wednesday morning. Review usually takes a day, so we'd go live Thursday or Friday.
[00:29] Hana: Hold the release until Monday. I don't want a launch going out on a Friday with nobody on call.
[00:36] Luis: Fair. Manual release, Monday at 10 a.m.
[00:39] Hana: And I'll write the release notes and send them to you by Tuesday.
[00:44] Luis: Great. Keep them under four lines, the store cuts off the rest.
